thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: cont-batch / kv-cache alert in us-east-1c — elevated kvcache.evictions and contbatch.timeout_count. Automatic page to on-call.
Priya V: I'm on it. Metrics show a sudden jump in max_batch_tokens utilization on nodes serving redwood-chat-ggml. Evictions started ~14:24 UTC.
Sam H: any recent model variant rollouts? I see a traffic shift to the experimental quant-llm-v2 around 14:00 — rollout percentage increased to 30% 14:05 UTC.
Rafael M: that variant was configured with aggressive batching: max_batch_tokens=32768 and max_num_seqs=300. I didn't realize the kvcache budget wasn't scaled accordingly. My bad.
Priya V: that aligns. High max_batch_tokens + high max_num_seqs -> KV cache inflation, then paging, then timeouts. Baseline pages/sec-> ~1k/sec, peaked to 14k/sec.
Support Ops: External impact: several enterprise tenants in us-east reported degraded responses and increased 504s since 14:20. Priority tickets coming in. No full outages but notable customer pain.
Priya V: mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout of quant-llm-v2, 2) revert contbatch config to last-stable, 3) apply kvcache soft limiter and aggressive eviction policy.
DeployBot: @Rafael M requested action: featureflag/variants/quant-llm-v2 -> pause-rollout. Starting canary stop on us-east-1c (10% nodes).
Rafael M: pausing now. Also will push hotfix to set max_batch_tokens=16384 and max_num_seqs=64. Patch snippet:
```
PATCH /api/v1/contbatch/config
{ "max_batch_tokens": 16384, "max_num_seqs": 64, "batch_timeout_ms": 50 }
```
Sam H: good. While that applies, enable a runtime breaker that rejects batches where projected_kv_growth > 1.5x current_budget to avoid cascade. Runtime key: contbatch.breaker.projection_threshold=1.5
Priya V: monitoring hooks: add temporary alarms for kvcache.evictions > 1000/min and contbatch.queue_depth > 200 to slack-alerting channel. If triggered, further throttle inbound routing to the variant.
Support Ops: informing customers: "We detected elevated latencies in us-east and are rolling a configuration rollback. Mitigation underway; updates shortly."
DeployBot: hotfix canary applied to us-east-1c-a. Observability window 90s.
Priya V: canary after 2m: evictions down 68%, p95 token latency down from 1.2s -> 230ms on canary nodes, error rate down from 6.1% -> 0.8%.
Sam H: promote to full region rollout. Also add temporary routing rule: route.weight(quant-llm-v2) -> 0 until we validate autoscale and kvcache changes.
DeployBot: canary passed. Rolling to 100% us-east-1.
Rafael M: routing gate applied, variant traffic shifted back to stable model. Hotfix rollout complete.
Priya V: we saw a handful of 429s from the breaker during the first minute but prevented margin exhaustion. No node OOMs.
Support Ops: update sent to customers: mitigations applied; we will follow up with a postmortem and compensation if warranted.
Platform Eng: follow-ups to file: 1) add pre-merge validation that rejects contbatch configs where projected_kvcache_usage > configured_budget, 2) add simulation test that models increased max_batch_tokens * max_num_seqs combos, 3) make the breaker behavior default for model-variant rollouts.
Sam H: I'll own the simulation test. Rafael please open PR to add validation and bump rollout gating to require kvcache budget checks.
Rafael M: will open PR and add notes in the rollout docs. Also scheduling a smaller canary with adjusted autoscaler before reattempting quant-llm-v2.
Priya V: on-call note: if you see the pattern of rising kvcache.evictions + page_reads + contbatch.timeout_count within 10 minutes of a variant rollout, immediately: 1) stop variant rollout, 2) apply contbatch.rollback-last-stable, 3) enable kvcache.soft_limit and breaker.
IncidentBot: Incident mitigated and monitoring stable for 10m. Closing active incident; please add timeline and diffs to #postmortems.
Priya V: creating the postmortem draft and timeline now. Will attach graphs, hotfix diff, and action items. Thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:
